svg.title: SDLC tracks by phase
svg.desc: The orchestrator's four tracks side by side, by phase (Define, Build, Prove, Ship with Learn). S, a fix: Define writes no documents and asks no approval, only Intent: and Repro: lines in the state file; one sonnet implementer makes the repro test fail first, then fixes it, and verify.py passes; no Prove; Ship learns a lesson only if there is one, asks the advisor once and commits on a branch without asking. M lite (risk low, the default): the session writes intent.md, a Lite spec.md and plan.md, with a design only when the approach isn't obvious, and you approve once; Build runs natively or with one subagent, each acceptance criterion's test red first; no Prove; Ship learns, asks the advisor once and commits. M full (risk high, or on request): writing-specs and writing-plans write the spec and plan, and the approval also sets Prove run or skip; the session builds as the maker; Prove dispatches one fresh opus code-reviewer that checks each criterion's test and reviews the diff in one pass, plus a security reviewer when security-touched and a ui-reviewer on UI; a FAIL goes back to Build and a fresh checker re-checks; Prove skip goes to Ship. L, a project: an opus Define agent runs brainstorming, specs, design, plans and consistency while the main session only coordinates; one sonnet Build agent per part; Prove runs a fresh ac-checker and opus code-reviewer in parallel each round, plus security, ui and, at a backlog close, qa-tester; round 3 failing or one criterion failing twice goes to you; Ship adds retro.md. Every track ends in one commit on a feature branch; merge or PR waits for the user. hookify, security-guidance, model-router, role-guard and trust-anchor run on every track; verify-freshness and prove-budget only in Prove. Backlog slices skip Prove until the feature close. Deploy is the on-request /sdlc:deploy, not a phase.

g.text: /sdlc:start → the orchestrator picks the smallest track that fits
Sized by footprint, not by risk words: risk raises the review, not the number of steps
hookify: blocks rm -rf, force-push to main, secret values; warns on .only, console.log, comment noise
security-guidance: edit warnings, commit review only when security-touched · model-router + role-guard + trust-anchor
a few files to a few days,

Round 3 fails, or one AC fails
Learn: a lesson only, when there
A commit on a feature branch, reported. Merge or PR waits for your word; CI green before any merge.
Backlog (M or L, bigger than one session): each slice runs Build → one commit, no Prove; feature close runs Prove on the whole branch, then Ship.
Any code change after Build's gate goes back to Build: rerun verify.py; with Prove, through Prove again. Autopilot and other agents run M and L in one session.
/sdlc:deploy is on request, not a phase: the project's own deploy path, your go-ahead before production or a DB migration, smoke test, release.md.
